header.running_head: Standing Out of Respect for a Muslim

blocks.text: ﷺ whispered to me that he was going to pass away. I then became happy when he informed me that I would be the first of his family to meet him.'"[^1]
The Sahabah (RA) Stand up for Rasulullaah ﷺ
Hadhrat Hilaal (RAH) (narrates from Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) who) says that whenever Rasulullaah ﷺ left (their gathering), they stood up for him and would not sit until he entered his room.[^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Prohibits the Sahabah (RA) from Standing up for him

Hadhrat Abu Umaamah (RA) says, "When Rasulullaah ﷺ once came out to us taking support from his staff, we stood up for him. He then said, "Do not stand up as the non-Arabs stand up in honour of each other."[^3]

Hadhrat Ubaadah bin Saamit (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ once came out to them, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) (may Allaah shower His mercy upon him) said, "Stand up and seek help from Rasulullaah ﷺ in your case against the hypocrite." However, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "None should stand! Allaah is the only One for Whom people ought to stand up."[^4]
The Practice of the Sahabah (RA) in this regard

Hadhrat Anas (RA) says, "There was none whom the Sahabah (RA) loved to see more than Rasulullaah ﷺ. Despite this, they would not stand up for him when they saw him because they knew that he disliked it."[^5]

Hadhrat Naafi reports from Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) that Rasulullaah ﷺ forbade a person from making another stand up from his place and then sitting in the same place. Therefore, whenever someone stood up from his place for Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA), he would not sit there.[^6]

Hadhrat Abu Khaalid Waalibi says that when Hadhrat Ali (RA) once came out to them, they stood waiting for him to go ahead. Hadhrat Ali (RA) reprimanded them saying, "Why do I see you people standing with your chests out (like soldiers)?"[^7]

Hadhrat Abu Mijlaz reports that when Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) once came out while Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Aamir (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) were seated. Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Aamir (RA) stood up while Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) who was the larger of the two remained sitting.
